notes.subject: bophelo
notes.rationale: נפש ke motho wa go hema — maphapo a throat/bophelo, e sego 'moya' fela

notes.subject: וחדל לעולם
notes.rationale: 'go fela go lehleleme' kgatlhanong le 'e a emišwa' — Hlahele-canoned: pholoso e a hlwa, ga e phethegele lehileng

notes.subject: יקר/חדל
notes.rationale: go hlabakanya: pholoso e jwa kudu eupša e emela go fela — lentšu la hlabakanya

translation: gomme e babjwa kudu pholoso ya bophelo bja bona, gomme e a fela — go fihla lehileng.
